George Meredith, The Shaving of Shagpat.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/george-meredith/the-shaving-of-shagpat

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- George Meredith, the author, died 1909 (Wikidata Q90238, P570 = 1909-05-18).

First publication of the text used: 1856, United Kingdom (SE colophon: 'The Shaving of Shagpat was published in 1856 by George Meredith.'; Wikipedia infobox for The Shaving of Shagpat: publication place United Kingdom, publication date 1856, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Shaving_of_Shagpat).

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1856, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 1951.
- Country of origin (United Kingdom): copyright there lasts for life plus 70 years
  after the death of the last surviving person named above. The last to die
  did so in 1909, so the work entered the public domain there on
  1 January 1980.
